release.label: SPHEREx Quick Release Spectral Images - QR2
release.note: QR2 supersedes QR1 (retired February 2026) and is the default returned by the Data Explorer and the IRSA SIA service.

selection_evidence.conclusion: The NEP is one of the SPHEREx Deep Fields and is revisited on hundreds of distinct dates across ~17 months of the mission, so it satisfies the demo's temporal-coverage requirement with large margin.

product.data_model: One 2D Spectral Image per detector per exposure; native 2040x2040; the wavelength at each pixel is given by the WCS-WAVE lookup table, so the frame is spatial x spatial with a per-pixel wavelength.

IMAGE.content: calibrated surface-brightness flux density; header BUNIT is an abbreviation that drops /sr

ZODI.content: model zodiacal-light background; NOT subtracted from IMAGE

PSF.content: oversampled PSF cube (QR2) / EPSF table (QR3); superseded by the ePSF product

WCS-WAVE.content: control-point lookup of central wavelength and bandwidth; VISUALIZATION ONLY (see related_science_products.spectral_wcs)

related_science_products.spectral_wcs: spectral_wcs_D2_spx_cal-wcs-v*_*.fits — CWAVE/CBAND per-pixel wavelength and bandwidth; science-grade replacement for WCS-WAVE
related_science_products.solid_angle_pixel_map: solid_angle_pixel_map_D2_spx_cal-sapm-v*_*.fits — per-pixel solid angle (arcsec^2), for surface-brightness to flux conversion
related_science_products.epsf: epsf_D2_spx_cal-epsf-v*_*.fits — effective PSF; supersedes the QR2 PSF cube and is recommended for all images
related_science_products.flux_corrections: l3_flux_corrections_D2_spx_cal-flxc-v*_*.fits — per-pixel gain scaling to combine QR2 with QR3 (QR3 only)

retrieval.search: IRSA SIA2 (RESPONSEFORMAT=CSV) with COLLECTION=spherex_qr2 and POS=circle 270 66.5 0.05
retrieval.cutout: Append ?center=RA,Dec&size=deg to any archive_url; size is in degrees. Verified byte-reproducible.
retrieval.cloud_mirror: s3://nasa-irsa-spherex/qr2/ (us-east-1, no AWS account; aws s3 ls --no-sign-request)

rights.terms: IRSA public data, no usage restrictions
rights.acknowledgement: This publication makes use of data products from the Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer (SPHEREx), which is a joint project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the California Institute of Technology, and is funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
rights.redistribution: Permitted. No raw FITS files are committed to this repository; the manifest records URLs and checksums so the same cutouts can be fetched on demand.

caveats: The two epochs were taken at different spacecraft pointings, so the same sky patch lands at different pixel offsets and orientations (see cutout_wcs_reference.crpix). A valid blink requires WCS reprojection onto a common tangent plane; a raw pixel difference would be wrong.
RESOLVED (M2-A): the images are surface brightness in MJy/sr (VARIANCE in (MJy/sr)^2); the header BUNIT=MJy is an abbreviation that drops /sr. See docs/spherex-m2a-validation.md.

RESOLVED/GATED (M2-A): WCS-WAVE is visualization-grade and its edge control points are invalid. Use the Spectral WCS product CWAVE/CBAND for any scientific wavelength. See docs/spherex-m2a-validation.md.

GATED (M2-A): cross-epoch photometric comparison must account for pipeline-version differences. This pair shares pipeline 6.4+psffix1 (v20); a QR2 vs QR3 comparison additionally requires the QR2-to-QR3 flux corrections. See docs/spherex-m2a-validation.md.

demo_scope.primary: nep — the M2/M3 acceptance dataset (reproducible, controlled comparison)
demo_scope.secondary: comet-3i-atlas — an optional known-moving-object demonstration, validated only at the data-validation stage (M3-D); never merged into the NEP workflow

alternatives_considered.description: IRSA publishes a curated SPHEREx spectral-image set for the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS.
alternatives_considered.status: VALIDATED (data only): 259 exposures / 133 pointings in spherex_qr2, calib_level=2, target_moving=true, all six detectors, two campaigns (2025-08-01..15 and 2025-12-08..14); low S/N and spatially extended. Held as the optional second example; adoption gated on M3-D.

alternatives_considered.description: SPHEREx Target List of Ice Sources (SPLICES), an IRSA-hosted catalogue.
alternatives_considered.status: not selected; catalog-only, no image blink

open_questions: Confirm the definitive SPHEREx deep-field pointing centre and footprint from the Explanatory Supplement rather than the SIA centroid used here.
Quantify the real change signal at the NEP between these two epochs once WCS reprojection is available (M3).
